reviewer_summary.question: Why can the model process the prompt together but choose its answer only one token at a time?
reviewer_summary.takeaway: The prompt is already known, but each answer choice must go back through the model before the following choice can be made, with saved earlier work reused along the way.

findings.problem: A layer is introduced through transforming lists and passing outputs into another layer before I see any list change. The empty rows give me places to look, but I am being asked to hold the new operation and the connection between operations before either has happened on the example.

resolution.note: Shows actual is input and layer-one output as a concrete transformation before locating the stack. Visual reread required.

findings.problem: I hear that context is mixed, but the picture only replaces one list with another. I cannot see what came from The and sky or how those inputs contributed to the changed numbers for is. Naming this attention leaves a causal step hidden; I could mistake it for simply adding the three lists.

resolution.note: Remaining beginner concern retained openly. This film scopes attention and feed-forward as blocks; the interactive model view exposes the full computed matching and feed-forward arithmetic. Automated takeaway is correct, but this is not human learning acceptance; owner and five-learner review remain pending.
